== Summary ==
GEMP import file for [[2022 MPC David Woods DS SSA Walkers]], rebuilt on 2026-11-04 by Holocron Claude from the decklist on that page. The original GEMP file from the event was not preserved. Each card's blueprintId comes from its wiki card page (GEMP id). Cards kept outside the deck (such as Defensive Shields) are not included.
